recent_items.summary: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. recent_items.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
